notes: Heading προγινώσκοντές on knowledge follows rule 91's operational test: the corpus spends the know/knowledge word on the γνω- family, and having is the empty support element. The of belongs to the frame, με being accusative (rule 106).
τῆς is emptied by the possessive adjective ἡμετέρας, which names the possessor itself (rule 54); of then stays with θρησκείας under rule 21's determinerless clause.
